## Source: amazon-inspector (b45c1955c79e273606d03c306ed76cc4a82ffc36946de35cb333ee78bc6de324)
Review of solivoxtts 0.1.0 did not surface any behavior that harms a party installing the package. No install-time or import-time network activity, credential or filesystem access outside the package's own directory, lifecycle shell execution, obfuscated payloads, or hardcoded exfiltration endpoints were observed. No third-party credentials or author secrets were found embedded in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (c512c506dd4828aef5dd993cce389de4500f6c2e3c1906f1440e71cf455c64e7)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
